independence.mutationScope: Only this new review record is authored; no product, test, producer, prior evidence, backlog, Git history, system configuration or remote changes.
independence.method: Read the actual producers, reports, setup and phase logs; recompute reported statistics and compare observations; independently hash named artifacts and the 336 explicitly bound source files. Scoped normal-account read-only access authenticated the owned fixture inputs and four phase logs after sandbox access was denied. No permissions or settings were changed.

inputAuthentication.boundary: Producer-held Windows file handles deny writes, replacement and deletion of selected existing inputs during measurement. Gateway runtime binding covers discovered import-time files, not every possible future dynamic library. This review does not create reusable benchmark or native/principal evidence.

observations.percentileMethod: Nearest rank: sorted warm sample 50 for p50 and 95 for p95; all 100 retained.

gateway.scope: Protected SQLCipher journal I/O with in-memory fixture keys and a synthetic zero-delay adapter; includes fixture dispatch/result construction, validation and routing. Excludes production lifecycle factory, native UI, packaging and live model/provider execution.
gateway.executionContext: Reported fresh normal Windows principal invocation at the fixed candidate with no concurrent agent tests or builds.
gateway.instrumentationLimit: Optional aggregate host counters were omitted after attempt-02 collector startup was denied by Windows. No benchmark ran in that attempt. No simultaneous utilization, load-correlation or I/O-causality claim is supported.

processResource.scope: Fresh sequential subprocess success replay and intentional abrupt exit of an owned child, then recovery through the routing gateway and repository using a newly owned explicit Windows DPAPI fixture vault plus SQLCipher. Policies and adapters are synthetic. Resource values describe these processes and project files, not a new numeric acceptance budget.
exclusions: Actual model weights or live inference
Ordinary user vaults, policies, credentials or projects
Host power loss or physical storage failure
Global disk footprint or whole-application memory budget

baseline.currentRunClaim: Hard-ceiling PASS and an authenticated candidate calibration observation only; not a comparison against an already reviewed gateway baseline.
baseline.prospectiveRoute: A separate criterion-linked baseline record may be established from the exact retained observation with independent review, immutable identity, raw samples, method, hardware, source/runtime and producer bindings and adverse lineage. Bind its reviewed hash before any future qualifying comparison. No such record is authored or approved here.
baseline.proposedComparison: Future p95 must also be no more than 1.2 times the exact reviewed baseline p95. Using this observation would yield approximately 26.888399943709373 ms, so the unchanged <25 ms ceiling remains stricter.

remainingQualificationLimits: This evidence increment does not approve the CAP-07.S01 slice, complete W1 qualification, satisfy independent Wave review, activate a later Wave or authorize release.

Fresh full affected/repository/deployment-profile qualification and the clean-state combined slice evidence remain separate obligations; prior selected checks and these two reports do not replace them.

Cancellation acknowledgement, 1000-manifest timing, native Model Center/accessibility, handoff and supported migration/lifecycle coverage must remain explicitly mapped to their own authenticated evidence; no additional checks are invented here.

Native catalog read uses confined-root POST /projects/models. The earlier GET-based harness allowance concern is retracted; this review does not justify a fixture allowlist extension. Actual native proof remains separate.
No model-use permission, rights, classification, budget, egress or security authority is granted by fixture success.
The protected witness remained filename/status-only and was not read, hashed, copied, scanned, edited, staged, deleted or ignored. Excluded sibling contents were not accessed.
No actual user research, ordinary vault/policy/credentials, native UI, remote service, provider or account settings were accessed by this authentication.
No output of this review replaces prior evidence, findings, approvals or failed attempts. No reusable-evidence or full dynamically loaded runtime closure claim is made.
conclusion: No blocking discrepancy was found in the two declared bounded observations. Their report, producer, source and log bindings support the stated fixture outcomes, with all limitations and adverse history retained.
